experiment: E0 multi-seed: C0 vs S1 across independent training seeds

purpose.Q1: Does S1's removal of right-arm-state brittleness replicate across training seeds (and does C0's brittleness replicate)?
purpose.Q2: Is there a competence cost of S1 relative to C0 once between-seed training variance is accounted for?
purpose.Q3: How large is training-seed variation compared with evaluation-sampling variation and scenario variation?
purpose.no_selection: No final policy is selected by this experiment; the outcome is a recommendation only, the decision belongs to the owner.

training_seeds.note: seed 0 = the a-priori V1 seed, never selected on outcome

fixed_training.deviation_D1: new runs use torch threads=3 (0.79 s/step) instead of 4 (1.28 s/step on the current VM, oversubscribed with the data-loader worker); thread count changes floating-point reduction order, so seed-0 (threads=4) and new seeds are not bit-comparable; they are independent realisations. A sensitivity analysis excluding seed 0 is part of the analysis.

analysis.per_seed_statistic: success proportion on each fixed evaluation set
analysis.across_seed_variation: arm mean, sample SD (n=3), range of per-seed proportions; reported separately per scenario
analysis.within_seed_sampling: Wilson 95% CI per seed per set; ratio of between-seed SD to binomial SE reported
analysis.across_scenario_variation: separate tables for NOM, BOUND21, BOUND22 and each shortcut mode; scenario x seed matrix
analysis.inference: Welch t on per-seed proportions (df Welch-Satterthwaite); exact permutation p over seed labels (min two-sided p=0.1 for 3 v 3) as secondary; hierarchical bootstrap (resample seeds then episodes) as sensitivity only

rules.R1_robustness_replicates: SUPPORTED iff S1 SI >= 0.90 for BOTH right_mean and jitter_small in >= 2 of 3 S1 seeds AND C0 SI <= 0.25 for ALL 3 C0 seeds; otherwise NOT SUPPORTED / MIXED

R2_competence_cost.rule: difference = mean(S1)-mean(C0) of per-seed proportions in pp; NON-INFERIOR if Welch 95% CI lower bound >= margin (NOM: -10 pp; BOUND (pooled seeds 21+22): -15 pp); COST EVIDENT if CI upper bound < 0; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE

rules.R3_recommendation: S1 may be RECOMMENDED FOR FURTHER STUDY as a V2 baseline candidate iff R1 SUPPORTED and R2 NON-INFERIOR on both NOM and BOUND. R1 SUPPORTED but R2 INCONCLUSIVE -> report 'inconclusive, more seeds needed' with required n. R2 COST EVIDENT -> recommend NOT adopting S1's floor as-is. Never auto-adopt; the owner decides.
rules.expected_power_note: with 3 seeds per arm and an assumed between-seed SD of ~8 pp the 95% CI half-width of the difference is ~18 pp, so only large effects are resolvable; INCONCLUSIVE is a likely, acceptable outcome

stop_rules: average training speed over the first 200 steps of any new run > 1.10 s/step -> stop and report
projected total > 8.0 h -> stop and report
any evaluation command with a seed in forbidden_seeds -> abort
a crashed run may be re-run once with identical arguments, never with changed parameters
no parameter, threshold or evaluation-set change after this file is frozen

forbidden: adopting S1 or S2 as V2 baseline
